title: The landing is heard: the thrust bed rides the plume and the tank's pneumatics play the legs, the shock and the door; the first gesture over a page-opening shot starts the sound instead of skipping it
context: Owner's third playtest (a996e005, 2026-09-30): "0) the landing need a sound of rocket thrusters landing and gears moving. If we do not have one I will provide." He chose our own sounds for now. src/fx/arrival.js made no sound; only the story lab scored the landing (src/labs/story-tab.js audioSync). And the landing could never have been heard on a fresh load: the browser starts audio on the first gesture, and any gesture skipped the shot. The controller sat exactly on its line, byte and long-line budgets, so the change had to be paid for.
outcome: The camera-shot system (one timed camera override, its skip listeners, its hang watch) moved out of src/td-tab.js into src/fx/camera-shot.js unchanged in behaviour, with one new option: `unlock: true` spends the first gesture on the sound and lets the next one skip. The arrival passes it while the audio context does not exist yet, on both its shots. The arrival plays the lab's score through storyApi.sfx: rocket_thrust loops under the burn at a gain and rate that follow the plume and stops at touchdown; tank_spool_up plays as the legs deploy, tank_spool_down on the landing shock, tank_spool_up at 0.85 rate as the door opens. The owner's own files, when they come, replace the manifest entries in STORY_SOUNDS. The tutorial card's NEXT still skips in one press. td-tab 9,417 -> 9,330 lines, 536,282 -> 532,453 bytes, 16 long lines; budgets lowered.
alternatives: Wait for the owner's files: he chose ours now.
A TAP FOR SOUND card before the landing: one more screen before the game, and the tutorial card over the landing already offers NEXT as an explicit skip.
Let the first gesture skip as before: the landing stays silent on every fresh load, which is the owner's complaint.
evidence: npm test (153 programs), npm run check, npm run architecture.

Browser --chapters (new step chapters-landing-sound): on a bare story page the first key leaves the arrival shot playing and starts the audio context, the legs' pneumatics are cued, the second key skips the landing; chapters-landing's NEXT still skips in one press. --grow and --skip-tutorial green.
